supporting_observations.claim: The alerted account, ext.rwong, was created at 13:44:07 UTC by nora.blake.
The account creation was preceded by a network logon for nora.blake from WS-NBLAKE-01 to the domain controller.
Seven seconds after creation, ext.rwong was added to Freelancers, matching the stated help-desk practice for temporary accounts.
The creator is the listed help-desk account, which is permitted to create domain accounts; the observed account name and group membership match the stated temporary-account pattern.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, including the account creation time; proxy activity during that interval cannot be assessed from this source.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish the business purpose or approval record for ext.rwong.
The evidence does not establish whether ext.rwong was used after creation.
unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect vpnui.exe was launched under nora.blake's session. The inventory states there is no VPN; these records show the client launch but do not establish a VPN connection. Review separately. (T048-00009, T048-00010, T048-00011)
